links.outcome: Share of real ChatGPT health conversations rated high-risk for safety
links.effect: Roughly one in five health conversations received a high-risk rating. Failure modes included unsafe medication or dosage guidance, harmful self-diagnosis, and encouraging over-reliance on the model.
links.quote: Roughly one in five health conversations receives a high-risk rating.

links.outcome: Failure of ChatGPT responses to refer users to professionals or give safety warnings
links.effect: Failure to refer users to professionals and missing safety warnings were among the recurring failure modes. About one in four conversations rated safe in isolation were unsafe for the specific user.
links.quote: Risk concentrates in symptom and condition queries and recurs through identifiable failure modes: unsafe medication or dosage guidance, harmful self-diagnosis, missing safety warnings, encouraging over-reliance on the model, and failure to refer users to professionals.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating LLM health advice safety using real user conversations rather than synthetic vignettes
Scoring response safety with user-context-aware rubrics that use the user's accumulated context
Demographically grounded (age and gender) safety evaluation of consumer chatbot health conversations in Global South countries

screen.reason: Empirical analysis of real-world user conversations with ChatGPT for health advice across four Global South countries, evaluating safety risks and contextual failure modes without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
